spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Jasper MacLeod. I’ve just noticed you’ve cut the interest rate on my savings account. I haven’t seen any letter about it, and I’m really unhappy with the way the bank’s handled this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Jasper. I’ll take a look at the account for you. First, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’m sorry you’ve had to chase this. We’ll get the interest you’ve missed returned to you, and I’ll check what’s happened.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Well, I want to know why the rate went down and why nobody told me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. Which savings account is it, and roughly when did you notice the rate change?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The Easy Access Saver. I noticed today, but the rate looks like it changed around the start of September.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right, thanks. I can see the rate changed on 2 September. I can’t see a letter recorded here at the moment, but the team will review the notification and the interest calculation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s exactly the problem. I shouldn’t have to find it out by checking the account myself.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re unhappy, and I’m sorry about that. I’ll put a note on the account that you’re unhappy about the rate change and not receiving a letter.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, but I do expect the interest to be put right.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. The review will confirm the amount due, and as I said, we’ll get any missed interest returned to you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The team will review the rate change, the notification record and the interest calculation, then send you a full written response within 8 weeks. That’s what happens next.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Jasper. Thanks for calling Thistle Bank.
